name: romdev-platform-gba
description: Game Boy Advance binaries + C library tree for romdev: mGBA emulator core + arm-none-eabi-gcc toolchain (cc1 / as / ld / objcopy / objdump) + the GBA C library share/ tree (libtonc, libgba, maxmod, sysbase, crt0, ldscripts). WASM. Single-consumer: the GBA platform.
author: Luis Montes
